title: Brand mark · Accredited Program mark lock-up options
slide_intent: Teach designers how to adapt the direction and line count of the mark while keeping the local program legible.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can offer a consistent family of local identifiers across print and digital communications.
demonstration: Each print and online specimen carries the same Program Name line. The options change the position of the symbol, the line breaks and the overall axis.
practical_value: Match the local identifier to the available width and placement. For a longer name, consult the adapted version on the next page.

content_islands.name: Lockup guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the placement rationale and four named options at left.

content_islands.name: Print variants
content_islands.spec: Compare two-line, single-line and centered program marks within one ruled display. Keep the program line visible under the logotype.

content_islands.name: Online variant
content_islands.spec: Separate the left-symbol mark under the online band. Place the full-lockup warning at right.
